title: Tangent vectors at a rational point as functionals on the cotangent space
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a $k$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $x\in X$ be a point whose residue field [def-weil-residue-field] satisfies $\kappa(x)=k$ (the map $k\to\kappa(x)$ is an isomorphism); let $\mathfrak m_x$ be the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and write $a\mapsto\bar a$ for the residue map $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\kappa(x)=k$. Let $T_{X/k,x}$ be the tangent space with its $k$-vector space structure [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space], whose elements are morphisms of $k$-schemes $\theta:\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]\to X$. For $\theta\in T_{X/k,x}$ let $\theta^\sharp:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to k[\epsilon]$ be the map induced by $\theta$ on stalks at the closed point $z$ of $\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon]$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], followed by the inverse of the germ isomorphism $k[\epsilon]\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}k[\epsilon],z}$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring]. Then: (a) $\theta^\sharp(a)=\bar a+D_\theta(a)\epsilon$ for a unique map $D_\theta:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to k$; (b) the rule $(a\bmod\mathfrak m_x^2)\mapsto D_\theta(a)$ for $a\in\mathfrak m_x$ is a well-defined $k$-linear map $\ell_\theta:\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2\to k$; (c) $\theta\mapsto\ell_\theta$ is a $k$-linear isomorphism $T_{X/k,x}\to\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2,k)$.

proof.text: Extract the linear coefficient map L using linear descent. Its coefficients D are additive and vanish on the structural field.

Equality of L values gives equality of D on m. For arbitrary a, choose c with r(c)=res(a). The element a-s(c) is in m, so additivity and vanishing on s(k) give equality of D(a). Thus the entire stalk maps agree. The Spec-local-ring correspondence recovers the tangent vectors, proving injectivity.

Realize any cotangent functional ell. Its coefficient D equals the coefficient from linear descent by taking second coordinates and using injectivity of r. Equality on maximal-ideal representatives gives L(theta)=ell, proving surjectivity.

Bundle the bijective linear map as a linear equivalence. Take the coefficient function supplied by linear descent. Any competing function has the same r-valued second coordinates, hence is equal by injectivity of r. This gives the exists-unique clause with the prescribed functional values.

D : R → k, (∀ a : R, sharp a = TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((X.residue x).hom a) + TrivSqZeroExt.inr (r (D a))) ∧ (∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R, e θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).toCotangent a) = D a)
